raw.details:
About the Event

Get ready to think, innovate, and build! Hack X Among Us is a hackathon organised as part of TECHNO-UTSAV 5.0 at ADGIPS. The event is open to students pursuing B.Tech, BCA, and other technical degrees from colleges and universities across India. It provides participants with a platform to develop innovative, technology-driven solutions to real-world challenges, collaborate with peers from different institutions, and showcase their problem-solving skills.

Inspired by the theme Among Us, the event also features a fun side quest: Find the Imposter!

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to students pursuing B.Tech, BCA, or any other technical degree.
  • Students from all colleges and universities are eligible to participate.
  • No restrictions on college, branch, or specialisation.
  • Each team must consist of 1–4 members.

Event Timeline & Format

Round 1: Online PPT Submission

Teams must prepare and submit a PowerPoint presentation proposing an innovative solution based on one of the official hackathon tracks.

  • Last date for PPT submission: 20 October 2026, 11:59 PM IST
  • Maximum slides: 8, including the Thank You slide.
  • Theme: The PPT must follow the Among Us theme, creatively incorporating its visual elements and aesthetic.
  • Content: The presentation should clearly explain the problem being addressed, the proposed solution, key features, technical approach, feasibility, and potential impact.
  • Demo Video: Teams may also submit a demo video showcasing their proposed solution, software, or workflow, if available.
  • Selection: Teams will be shortlisted based on the evaluation of their PPT submissions.
  • Shortlisting Results: 21 October 2026, 12:00 PM (noon).

Important: Teams are expected to start developing their prototypes, software, or workflow automations alongside their PPT preparation. Shortlisted teams must be ready to present and demonstrate their developed solutions during the offline finale.

Incomplete or late submissions may not be considered.

Round 2: Offline Prototype Presentation

  • Date: 23 October 2026
  • Venue: ADGIPS
  • Shortlisted teams will present their solutions and demonstrate their developed prototypes, software, or workflow automations before the judging panel.
  • Teams must explain their technical approach, demonstrate their solutions, and answer questions from the judges.
  • Final winners will be selected based on innovation, problem-solving, technical feasibility, implementation, potential impact, and presentation.

Tracks

Participants must choose a project idea from one of the officially announced tracks:

  • Healthcare – Technology-driven solutions addressing healthcare challenges.
  • Agriculture – Innovations supporting farmers and improving agricultural practices.
  • Tech Innovation – Creative applications of technology to solve real-world problems.
  • Machine Learning – Solutions leveraging machine learning and data-driven approaches.
  • Education – Technology-based solutions enhancing learning and accessibility.
  • Open Innovation – Innovative solutions addressing problems beyond the specified tracks.

Rules & Guidelines

  • Open to students pursuing B.Tech, BCA, or any other technical degree from any college or university.
  • Each team must consist of 1–4 members.
  • Students from different colleges, branches, and specialisations can form teams.
  • Teams must register through the official Unstop event page.
  • Teams must select a track from the officially announced list.
  • The PPT must be original and prepared by the participating team.
  • Teams must adhere to the submission deadline and all instructions communicated by the organisers.
  • Shortlisted teams must develop their solutions before the offline finale and be prepared to present and demonstrate their prototypes.

Evaluation Criteria

Submissions and final presentations may be evaluated on:

  • Innovation and originality
  • Relevance to the selected track
  • Problem-solving approach
  • Technical feasibility and implementation
  • Practical application and potential impact
  • Clarity and quality of presentation

Event Details

  • Event Name: Hack X Among Us
  • Organised Under: TECHNO-UTSAV 5.0
  • Venue: ADGIPS
  • Online Submission Deadline: 20 October 2026, 11:59 PM IST
  • Shortlisting Results: 21 October 2026, 12:00 PM
  • Offline Finale: 23 October 2026
  • Team Size: 1–4 members
  • Registration Platform: Unstop

Bring your creativity, collaborate with your team, and turn your ideas into impactful solutions.

Think Smart. Build Together. Find the Imposter!

Join the Official WhatsApp Community

Join our WhatsApp community to receive important announcements, submission guidelines, shortlisting updates, and information about the offline finale.

Join here: https://chat.whatsapp.com/KIT29977Wpg4cSVqn2oum0

Stay connected and get ready to innovate!
